object.attr: analysis: the exported PDF shows no link states, so a PDF issued past the export warning, or over MCP where nothing warns, reads as fully reviewed (architecture review; CF-P22). Decided with MELLON-PDF-SRS-56 and MELLON-PDF-SRS-169 as one decision on 2026-11-11 (review Q37).
object.description: When the document has outgoing links whose link state is suspect, broken or unknown, the cover page shall state how many outgoing links are in each of the three states.
